title: Stockfish, But It Plays the 2nd Best Move...
summary: 'BetaFish': Stockfish always plays the second best move in any position. Player (white) develops normally knowing the best reply (...d5) is never played, then creates positions where only one good reply exists (e.g. captures where the best move is the only recapture). When only one legal move exists the bot plays it. Player wins with Bxc6+ and Be5+ ideas, defeating Beta Fish in game 1.
rules: Each bot move: play the engine's 2nd best move.
If only one legal move exists, play it (no forfeit).
win_condition: Checkmate the bot. Video: won game 1.
